question: Can you provide the total number of sessions for each traffic channel in December 2020, using the information from the 'event_params'
sql:
WITH session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT VALUE.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') as session_id,
    (SELECT VALUE.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'medium') as medium,
    (SELECT VALUE.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'source') as source,
    event_timestamp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
first_params AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    medium,
    source,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_timestamp ASC) as rn
  FROM session_params
  WHERE medium IS NOT NULL OR source IS NOT NULL
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN TRIM(SOURCE) = '(direct)' AND TRIM(MEDIUM) IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%push' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%mobile%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'organic' AND LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') AND (LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') AND (LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') AND (LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') AND (LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%retargeting%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel
  FROM first_params
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) as total_sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC
